meta.title: DC (Handlooms) Weavers Database — campaign-enriched cluster seed
meta.sourceNote: Hub seed enriched from public National Handloom Day campaign PDFs (state lists + Complete list district.pdf). weaverCount = district-matched listing rows; densityWeight = within-state campaign density rank. Products / weaves / GI / society names ingested; phones, emails, and street addresses are never stored. Not a live API; not Fourth Handloom Census.
meta.disclaimer: Campaign listing seed — density and counts reflect showcase PDF rows, not census population.

coverage.note: Major hubs mapped to PDF districts/products; unmapped hubs keep soft state-level density floor.
